oil.when: 2022 Wagoneer and Grand Wagoneer (cluster menu method)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Keep your foot off the brake and press ENGINE START/STOP so the ignition is in ON/RUN with the engine not running.
Press the down arrow on the steering wheel until the cluster shows Vehicle Info.
Press the right arrow to open the Oil Life screen.
Press and hold OK until the oil life reads 100%. If a message says the engine must be off with the ignition in run, switch the engine off and try again.
Press the up arrow to leave the menu.
oil.note: If the oil message is back at the next start, the reset did not take; repeat it or use the accelerator pedal method below.

oil.when: 2022–2025 Wagoneer and Grand Wagoneer (accelerator pedal method)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Keep your foot off the brake and press ENGINE START/STOP so the ignition is in ON/RUN. Do not start the engine.
Slowly push the accelerator pedal all the way to the floor and let it up, three times, all within ten seconds.
Switch the ignition off without pressing the brake.
Start the engine. If the oil change message shows again, the reset did not take, so repeat the steps.
oil.note: Checked in the 2022 owner's manual and the 2025 Wagoneer owner's handbook, which both give this pedal method.
